description: Build a bidirectional call graph centered on a symbol (who calls it + what it calls). Each branch keeps its direction: depth 2 = callers of callers, callees of callees. Use to understand control flow through a function. For flat list of all references use find_usages instead. Read-only. Returns JSON: { root: { symbol_id, name, calls: [...], called_by: [...] } }.

fqn.description: Fully qualified name to center the graph on

symbol_id.description: Symbol ID to center the graph on

name: get_call_graph
